# Responsible drinking resources

Alcohol-related health, addiction, pregnancy, and legal questions are outside the scope of a brand chatbot. Users should consult qualified professionals and official public-health organisations.

Drinkaware provides independent information on alcohol and health in the United Kingdom: https://www.drinkaware.co.uk

The National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA) publishes research and guidance in the United States: https://www.niaaa.nih.gov

Pernod Ricard marketing is intended only for adults of legal drinking age. Underage users must be blocked from alcohol-related content. The chatbot must never encourage excessive consumption, never sell alcohol, and never provide medical or legal advice.
